description: This PHP source file defines the InstallerPasswordStrengthService class, which extends the PasswordStrengthService and provides methods to enforce password policies such as length, character types, and spaces during user registration or password change processes within the OrangeHRM HRM system.
external_methods: PasswordStrengthService methods like checkMinPasswordLength(), checkMaxPasswordLength(), checkMinLowercaseLetters(), checkMinUppercaseLetters(), checkMinNumbersInPassword(), checkMinSpecialCharacters(), checkSpacesInPassword()

classes.name: InstallerPasswordStrengthService
classes.description: A service class that extends PasswordStrengthService to implement password policy checks such as length, character variety, and space restrictions.

methods.name: getTextHelper
methods.description: Returns a TextHelperService instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getMinLength
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum password length, defaulting to 8.

methods.name: getMaxLength
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum password length, defaulting to 64.

methods.name: getMinNoOfLowercaseLetters
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum number of lowercase letters required, defaulting to 1.

methods.name: getMinNoOfUppercaseLetters
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum number of uppercase letters required, defaulting to 1.

methods.name: getMinNoOfNumbers
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum number of numeric characters required, defaulting to 1.

methods.name: getMinNoOfSpecialCharacters
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum number of special characters required, defaulting to 1.

methods.name: getIsSpacesAllowed
methods.description: Retrieves whether spaces are allowed in passwords, defaulting to 'false'.

methods.name: checkPasswordPolicies
methods.description: Checks a given UserCredential against password policies and returns an array of violation messages.
